English.Char_Desc_2000:
Music Player plays the music on this computer, internet radio and Spotify, with big buttons and big words. My Music: Open a folder... plays every song in it and its subfolders; Add songs... and Add a folder... add more to the list. Your last folders stay as buttons; search, sort, shuffle and repeat the list, change the speed, and save or open playlists. The list and the place in the song are remembered. Radio: search about 50,000 free stations by name, type of music or country; the last hour is kept, so live radio can be paused, sent back and repeated, and Go live catches up. Spotify: the player's Play, Next, Previous, volume and Mute work the Spotify app (needs the Spotify app and an account). The sleep timer stops the music after a while or at the end of the song, and can then close the player, put the computer to sleep or shut it down, after a warning you can cancel. Free software under the GPL; its source code comes with it.
Before you install: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The installer is not code-signed (a signing certificate is a paid yearly service), so Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box: click More info, then Run anyway. A few antivirus programs wrongly flag new unsigned programs; you can check the download against the SHA-256 fingerprint on its release page. No administrator password is needed.

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: Music Player is free to use and share. Download sites may list it and offer the unchanged Setup.exe, or link to the download page.
Permissions.EULA: Music Player is free and comes with no warranty. Use it at your own risk. The free parts it is built from keep their own licenses, listed in the licenses folder it installs.
